inputs.prompt:
Create ONE photorealistic 16:9 cinema frame. STRICT REFERENCE ROLES: IMAGE 1 is the approved cast and actual room; IMAGE 2 is the exact approved woman identity crop. IMAGE 3 is ONLY the storyboard camera, framing, pose and outfit reference; NEVER copy that source actor's face or tattoos.
Match IMAGE 3's shallow-depth-of-field chest-up close-up of woman. Normal 65mm portrait perspective, NOT fisheye. Camera nearly eye level, woman three-quarter profile looking toward screen LEFT and down at the off-screen man. Face at x=60%, y=42%, short bob almost touches top edge; shoulders and ivory camisole straps fill lower center-right. Bright softly blurred window occupies LEFT background, wooden trim and vintage cabinet on far RIGHT. Preserve approved woman's exact facial identity and hair, same ivory lace camisole from IMAGE 1. Expression transitions into mild playful exasperation, lips slightly parted and brows lightly knit, not an exaggerated yell in the still. No man visible.
Preserve the exact approved character identity, haircut and age. Keep the warm timber room's textures and colors consistent with IMAGE 1, viewed from the camera position in the storyboard reference. Match the reference shot's face size, headroom, foreground/background arrangement and lens perspective precisely. No title, subtitles, captions, writing, logos or watermark anywhere. No extra people, duplicated limbs, collage or split screen. This is a shot from the same movie, not a new cast or generic portrait.
